name: POWER SUPPLY
text:
Power supply, as you can tell from the name is a device that supplies power to electrical infrared sauna parts.

Power supply work with specific different voltages, both input and output characteristics. So you should be looking for one that is suitable for your infrared sauna power demands. Voltage configuration is available with some power supply models.

If you’re looking for a replacement or an upgrade, maybe your current power supply is not working, or not functioning as it should - we can provide your with different options.

Resistance to humidity and heat is important for power supply modules, so you will be looking for ones to match the requirements of an infrared power supply.

We look forward to helping you improve your sauna experience.
text_short:
Power supply is a device that supplies electric energy to infrared sauna electrical equipment. The main function of power supply is to control the output voltage and convert one form of electrical energy to another.

We offer power supply devices with different input voltage and output power characteristics, so you may easily choose the one that fits your sauna perfectly. Voltage adjustments are available for the majority of power supply models.
